concerns.text: Task T020 (Conformational Ensemble) and T021 (Physics Descriptors) have no matching FR/SC in spec.md or plan.md. The spec strictly defines 3D descriptors as 'radius of gyration, asphericity, principal moments' (FR-004, FR-012). These tasks implement unrequested features (dynamic flexibility, H-bond capacity, planarity) creating scope creep with no traceable requirement.

Task T025 mandates training three distinct models (Baseline, Control, Upper Bound). Spec FR-005 and Plan Phase 1 Step 3 explicitly require training a *single* 2-layer MLP. There is no requirement to compare model configurations or train separate 'SMILES only' vs '3D only' models.

Task T027 implements a 'conditional two-stage permutation test' that reduces shuffles based on preliminary p-values. This contradicts Spec FR-016 and Plan Phase 2 Step 3, which mandate a fixed 10,000 shuffles for statistical validity. The conditional logic introduces non-determinism not authorized by the spec.

Task T028b (Comparative Analysis of three models) has no matching requirement. The spec and plan only authorize a single model. There is no FR/SC requiring a comparative analysis of different model architectures or feature subsets.

Task T030b (Simple Rule Search) implements a combinatorial enumeration of interaction rules to address a 'simulated reviewer concern'. No such requirement exists in spec.md or plan.md. This is untraceable scope creep.

Task T036b (Physical Constraint Validation) validates predictions against 'known physical limits' and 'X-ray powder diffraction logic'. No FR/SC in the spec requires this specific validation step or the generation of 'physical_constraint_validation.csv'.

Tasks T020, T021, T030b, and T036b reference external 'Reviewer' names (Kandel, Franklin, Pauling, Curie, Wolfram) in their descriptions. The spec.md and plan.md do not contain these comments. Embedding unincorporated external feedback into task descriptions creates confusion about mandatory vs. optional work.
